changelog:
- Initial release of the read-image skill for generating textual descriptions of images via a delegated vision-capable model.
- Allows users to describe images by dropping photos into folders or on request when the main session model lacks image input capability.
- Integrates with opencode run to route images to a vision model using the --file flag (supports multiple images).
- Provides recommendations for factual, neutral descriptions and handling of recognizable human faces for downstream video pipelines.
- Offers step-by-step guidance for arranging image sets into compelling narrative orders for essays, infographics, or videos.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for file handling and model selection.
summary: Generate textual descriptions of one or more images when the current session model (e.g. opencode/big-pickle) has no image input, by delegating to a vision-capable model on OpenRouter via `opencode run` with --file. Use when the user drops photos into imgs/, asks "can you read/describe these images", or an image needs a description for an article, portfolio, infographic, or video pipeline. Related terms: 看图, 描述图片, image description, vision model, glm-4.6v, --file.
